title: A MORAL- AND EVENT- CENTRIC INSPECTION OF GENDER BIAS IN FAIRY TALES AT A LARGE SCALE
reasoning: The study evaluates the presence of gender bias through the lens of 'moral foundations,' specifically using the extended Moral Foundations Dictionary (eMFD) to measure five dimensions of human morality: care/harm, fairness/cheating, loyalty/betrayal, authority/subversion, and sanctity/degradation.
